# PLAN — iteration 3

## Current state assessment

Iterations 1 and 2 were accepted for timing progress; the incumbent remains timing-infeasible at WNS −5.32 ns, with 128 FFs and 4 DSPs. The advisor’s product-register surgery also remained infeasible at −5.933 ns and showed a DSP cascade into `y_out`; adding pipeline state would violate the fixed cycle behavior.

## Hypothesis

For the exact default coefficient set, replacing the four constant multipliers with signed shift-add expressions should reduce DSP cascade delay and improve routed setup slack, at the possible cost of additional LUTs and carry logic.

## Instruction for generator

Keep `d[0:7]`, the synchronous active-high reset, registered `y_out`, and `// @latency 1` unchanged. Add a generate-time fast path for the exact default coefficients `(3,7,12,18,18,12,7,3)`, computing the symmetric pair products with 32-bit sign-extended shift-add forms; leave the existing parameterized paths intact for every other supported coefficient set. Preserve the existing balanced sum structure and 32-bit result semantics, including signed inputs and overflow. Do not register intermediate products or change cycle behavior; judge the proposal using the fixed verification gates and routed reports.
